## Create a flag

```http
POST /v1/projects/:projectId/flags
```

### Path parameters

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description        |
|-----------|--------|----------|--------------------|
| projectId | string | yes      | Project identifier |

### Request body

```json
{
  "key": "new-feature",
  "name": "New Feature",
  "type": "boolean"
}
```

### Responses

- `201` – Flag created with default disabled configuration in every environment.
- `404` – Project not found.
- `409` – Flag key already exists.

See the OpenAPI UI at `/docs` after starting the API for full request and response schemas.
